newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish central bank to publish new interbank rate.
newsitem.headline: Danish central bank to publish new interbank rate.

text.p: Denmark's central bank said on Wednesday that it would next month begin to calculate and publish a daily tomorrow/next interbank rate and abolish upper limits on the amount banks could place on deposit at the current deposit rate of 3.25 percent.

A statement from the bank said that it would start publishing the new interbank rate, a weighted average of similar rates from 14 participating banks, on May 2. Tomorrow-next refers to money lent today which matures the day after tomorrow.
The deposit limits, never actually applied since banks place as little as possible at the deposit rate, will end on May 1.
